source_request: Adoptar KiCad + FreeCAD + StepUp gratis, promoverlo con guía y ejemplos; editar y visualizar manualmente el conjunto, estudiar eliminación del saliente norte y carcasa estilizada incluso con partes visibles.
parent_objective: Piantor wireless 36-key exact geometry, slim modular hotswap keyboard
required_outcomes: Native FCStd assembly with named independent parts and editable dimensions
Matching KiCad placement study and tested StepUp exchange example
Concise public guide and reproducible manual-edit examples
Slender open-stack design comparison preserving all 36 key centres/angles
Updated public viewer and 3D exports consistent with current CAD
acceptance: Reopen FCStd with stock FreeCAD, change dimensions, recompute, save/reopen and compare geometry
KiCad files reopen; compare footprints and outline with native CAD; preserve net associations where supplied
Demonstrate StepUp import/exchange on disposable copy and verify actual geometric delta
Check solids, nominal collisions, exports and unchanged key geometry
Verify public files and viewer after normal main push
scope: Digital design and workflow; no purchases, printing, flashing or physical acceptance. Exposed modules permitted; battery retains insulating containment.
remaining_parent_requirements: Final PCB routing, cable routing, component dimensions/retention and physical fit
Integrated firmware, BLE, charging and measured power
